<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N – H – X)/2 and treating sulfur like oxygen (i.e., it does not affect the calculation), for C₁₂H₁₅O₂S we have C = 12, H = 15, N = 0, X = 0. DBE = (2·12 + 2 – 15)/2 = 11/2 = 5.5, which rounds to the nearest whole number of unsaturation units, giving 5.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
